verdict.rationale: A direct probe found a publicly downloadable OpenAPI document at developers.deepgram.com/openapi.json: it returned HTTP 200 and contains the "openapi" key, so an AI-native user can fetch a machine-readable spec without authentication. The machine-readable llms.txt and .md documentation pages complement it but are not themselves an API spec. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or linking the spec, confirmation of which endpoints it covers (REST /v1/listen, the WebSocket agent API), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
